queries: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), order_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM order_counts) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - oa.avg_order_count AS difference FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN order_average AS oa JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_order_count ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), order_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM order_counts), ranked AS (SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - oa.avg_order_count AS difference, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY oc.order_count DESC) AS order_rank FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN order_average AS oa JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_order_count) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference FROM ranked WHERE order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id ASC
